## Description

Models optimal order routing across fragmented liquidity venues using Mean-Field Game (MFG) Nash equilibria, minimizing total market impact and execution cost against competing algorithmic traders.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block orders, fragmented exchange routing, execution across multiple crypto or equity venues.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Brokers, Algorithmic Trading Desks, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Order book depth profiles across venues, historical volume curves, latency measurements.

## Caveats

Solving forward-backward stochastic differential equations in MFG requires specialized numerical PDE solvers.
